card.line: Gibeah was a city of Benjamin where a terrible crime led to war against the tribe, and where Saul, Israel's first king, later made his home.

moments.title: No Room for the Levite
moments.text: A Levite and his party passed by a foreign city and stopped at Gibeah for the night. He sat in the city square, but no one would take them into his home until an old man welcomed them.

moments.title: The Crime Told to Israel
moments.text: The Levite told the gathered Israelites that the men of Gibeah surrounded the house at night and abused his concubine, and she died. Israel vowed to punish Gibeah for this atrocity.

moments.title: Benjamin Defends Gibeah
moments.text: The Benjamites refused to hand over the wicked men of Gibeah. They gathered at Gibeah to fight Israel, and twice they struck down thousands of Israelites there.

moments.title: The Ambush and the Fall of Gibeah
moments.text: Israel set an ambush around Gibeah and drew the Benjamites away from the city. The men in ambush rushed in and put the whole city to the sword.

moments.title: Saul Goes Home
moments.text: After Samuel explained the rights of kingship to the people, Saul went home to Gibeah. Men of valor whose hearts God had touched went with him.
